scope: Fortnite competitive intelligence overlay for exhaustive EU ingestion, qualification graph and selective calendar projection.

principles.non_breaking_overlay: Keep all existing competition_id, phase_id, session_id and calendar_uid values from the V1 ledger. V2 adds policy and derived intelligence without rewriting unchanged history.
principles.ledger_complete_calendar_quiet: Ingest all sufficiently identified official EU sessions while keeping the visible calendar selective and action-oriented.
principles.explainable_projection: Every CALENDAR/FEATURED decision must store explicit reasons; scores are internal aids, not official Epic importance labels.
principles.qualification_is_graph: Advancement is represented by directed evidence-backed edges; timing coincidence never creates qualification.
principles.field_provenance: Material fields may carry their own source/evidence so a correction can replace one field without downgrading the whole competition.
principles.derived_rebuildable: Scores, indexes, conflicts and effective eligibility are rebuildable and never override canonical ledger data.

identity_v2.series_id: Recurring circuit/family such as FNCS, CASH_CUP or VICTORY_CUP.
identity_v2.edition_id: Officially distinguishable season/year/edition only; never synthesize from date alone.
identity_v2.session_id: One scheduled play window; rescheduling changes timing, not identity.
identity_v2.alias_policy: Title/translation/slug changes are aliases/history, never new identity by themselves.
identity_v2.replacement_policy: Real replacement uses REPLACED_BY; postponement keeps the same logical identity and schedule history.

series_policy.recurrence: Repeated cups get distinct competition_id values but may share series_id/edition_id when officially appropriate.
series_policy.anti_merge: Same title on a different date is not automatically the same competition.

field_provenance.resolution: Use the most field-authoritative official evidence and preserve the previous value in history.
field_provenance.no_noise: observed_at alone never causes a commit.

rules: QUALIFIES_TO/FEEDS_INTO are directional and never inferred in reverse.
UNKNOWN edges cannot drive projection, deadline or notification decisions.
Targets must resolve to a known node or sourced EXTERNAL_TARGET.
Advancement cycles are invalid; SAME_SERIES_NEXT_INSTANCE is exempt.
Global prize data never proves regional qualification slots.
Global schedule graph never claims a specific player/team qualified without a participant-specific evidence layer.
Never use session start as registration close unless official rules explicitly say so.
Check-in is distinct from registration and can have its own deadline.
Phase/session registration overrides competition defaults only inside that scope.
Unknown registration data stays unknown.
Increment only for material schedule changes.
Translation, checked_at and source fetch timestamps do not change revision.
Rescheduled session keeps session_id and records previous timing.
Never silently delete a session missing from one crawl.

missing_guard.confirmed_removal: REMOVED_CONFIRMED only with direct or persistently unambiguous official evidence.

hard_rules: Official FNCS Global Championship or equivalent top-tier global championship => FEATURED.
Official Fortnite LAN/in-person event in France => FEATURED unless cancelled.
UNKNOWN/DATE_ONLY session time cannot become an exact timed SESSION_ACTION VEVENT.
Routine test/performance sessions stay LEDGER_ONLY unless a separate hard promotion reason exists.
Already projected POSTPONED/CANCELLED events keep their UID for continuity.
projection_engine.currency_rule: Prize thresholds are ranking aids only; convert only with trusted contemporaneous FX data, otherwise omit prize-score.

projection_granularity.COMPETITION: One VEVENT for a logical tournament/run with nested sessions.
projection_granularity.PHASE: Use when phases have materially separate dates/actions and one card would hide planning value.
projection_granularity.SESSION_ACTION: Use only for a distinct registration/check-in/qualifier/final action with reliable timing.
projection_granularity.anti_bazar: Never create one VEVENT per game/match.

actionability.PLAY: Playable EU session with reliable time and applicable eligibility.
actionability.WATCH: Major competitive event worth following live.
actionability.FOLLOW: Important competition without a direct play/attendance action.
actionability.one_card_rule: A VEVENT can expose one primary action and secondary actions; do not duplicate cards just for action labels.

conflict_detection.surface_rule: Persist all conflicts; surface only if at least two conflicting items are CALENDAR/FEATURED or otherwise explicitly actioned.
conflict_detection.no_choice: Never decide which tournament should be played.

rules: Only inherit fields explicitly declared applicable to children.
Never inherit region/platform restrictions from a sibling or another region.
Unknown child eligibility remains UNKNOWN.
effective_eligibility is derived; canonical evidence stays at its source level.
Registration/check-in deadlines can be exported even for LEDGER_ONLY competitions when actionable.
LAST_QUALIFIER_AT is the last official qualifying session feeding a target, not generic event end.
SESSION_START_AT is a reminder source, not an end deadline.

result_policy.calendar_effect: Results alone never change DTSTART/DTEND or create a VEVENT.
result_policy.qualification_effect: Results can satisfy an advancement edge only in a participant-specific layer; the global graph remains structural.
result_policy.notify: Only major results or results that materially determine the next projected stage.

index_contract.authority: Index never overrides ledger/engine; rebuild if inconsistent.

notify: promotion caused by major qualification/actionable registration

ics_mapping_v2.sequence_rule: Technical V2 metadata alone never increments SEQUENCE; inject on the next real business write.

rules: Never rename existing IDs.
Existing visibility is initial projection_level until V2 evaluation.
Existing calendar_uid remains stable.
Existing history stays append-only.
Derived V2 fields need not be materialized on unchanged historical entries.
